## GET Flow
### Overview Diagram

```plantuml name=bulk-get-flow
@startuml
title Bulk API GET Flow

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontSize 14
skinparam sequenceMessageAlign left
skinparam responseMessageBelowArrow true
skinparam ParticipantPadding 20

actor User
participant "Public API" as PublicAPI #E8F4FD
participant "Bulk API" as BulkAPI #EAF7EA
database "Bulk DB" as BulkDB #FFF3CD
queue "SQS FIFO" as SQS #F3E8FF
participant "ECS Worker" as Worker #E8F4FD
participant "S3 / CloudFront" as Storage #FCE4EC

User -> PublicAPI : GET /v1/bulk/{resource}
activate PublicAPI

PublicAPI -> BulkAPI : Forward GET request
activate BulkAPI

BulkAPI -> BulkDB : Create task record\nstatus = CREATED
BulkDB --> BulkAPI : taskId

BulkAPI -> SQS : Send task message\nMessageGroupId = companyId\nDeduplicationId = taskId
SQS --> BulkAPI : Message accepted

BulkAPI -> BulkDB : Update status = QUEUED
BulkAPI --> PublicAPI : 202 Accepted\ntaskId

deactivate BulkAPI
PublicAPI --> User : taskId + status URL
deactivate PublicAPI

Worker -> SQS : Receive task message
activate Worker

Worker -> BulkDB : Update status = RUNNING
Worker -> Storage : Generate result file
Storage --> Worker : result path
Worker -> BulkDB : Update status = SUCCESS\nresultFilePath

deactivate Worker
@enduml

```

### How to write better code blocks now

* **Use this style:**

```java title="BulkTaskService.java"
public interface BulkTaskService {
    BulkCreateResponse createTask(BulkCreateRequest request);
}
```

* **SQL Example:**

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- 1. DATABASE SETUP
-- ============================================================================
-- Create the database if it does not already exist
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS CompanyDB;
USE CompanyDB;

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. TABLE SCHEMA CREATION (DDL)
-- ============================================================================

-- Create Departments Table (Parent Table)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS departments (
    department_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    department_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    location VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Main Campus'
);

-- Create Employees Table (Child Table with Foreign Key)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
    employee_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE,
    hire_date DATE NOT NULL,
    salary DECIMAL(10, 2) CHECK (salary > 0),
    department_id INT,
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Active',
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) 
        REFERENCES departments(department_id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL
);

-- ============================================================================
-- 3. DATA POPULATION (DML)
-- ============================================================================

-- Insert Departments
INSERT INTO departments (department_name, location) VALUES 
('Engineering', 'Building A'),
('Human Resources', 'Building B'),
('Marketing', 'Remote');

-- Insert Employees
INSERT INTO employees (first_name, last_name, email, hire_date, salary, department_id) VALUES 
('Alice', 'Smith', 'alice.smith@company.com', '2023-01-15', 85000.00, 1),
('Bob', 'Johnson', 'bob.johnson@company.com', '2023-06-20', 92000.00, 1),
('Charlie', 'Brown', 'charlie.brown@company.com', '2024-02-10', 60000.00, 2),
('Diana', 'Prince', 'diana.prince@company.com', '2022-11-05', 75000.00, 3);

-- ============================================================================
-- 4. DATA UPDATES & MAINTENANCE
-- ============================================================================

-- Give a 5% raise to all engineers
UPDATE employees 
SET salary = salary * 1.05 
WHERE department_id = 1;

-- ============================================================================
-- 5. DATA QUERIES & REPORTING (DQL)
-- ============================================================================

-- Fetch average salary grouped by department name for active departments
SELECT 
    d.department_name,
    COUNT(e.employee_id) AS total_employees,
    ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
WHERE e.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY d.department_name
ORDER BY average_salary DESC;
```

## 2. POST Flow

```plantuml name=bulk-post-flow
@startuml
title Bulk API POST / Import Flow

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontSize 14
skinparam sequenceMessageAlign left
skinparam responseMessageBelowArrow true
skinparam ParticipantPadding 20

actor User
participant "Public API" as PublicAPI #E8F4FD
participant "Bulk API" as BulkAPI #EAF7EA
database "Upload Session DB" as UploadDB #FFF3CD
database "Bulk DB" as BulkDB #FFF3CD
queue "SQS FIFO" as SQS #F3E8FF
participant "ECS Worker" as Worker #E8F4FD
participant "S3 / CloudFront" as Storage #FCE4EC

User -> Storage : Upload XML/CSV file\nusing upload session URL
Storage --> User : Upload complete

User -> PublicAPI : POST /v1/bulk/{resource}\nuploadSessionId
activate PublicAPI

PublicAPI -> BulkAPI : Forward POST request
activate BulkAPI

BulkAPI -> UploadDB : Validate upload session
UploadDB --> BulkAPI : uploadKey + owner info

BulkAPI -> BulkDB : Create import task\nstatus = CREATED
BulkDB --> BulkAPI : taskId

BulkAPI -> SQS : Send import task message
SQS --> BulkAPI : Message accepted

BulkAPI -> BulkDB : Update status = QUEUED
BulkAPI --> PublicAPI : 202 Accepted\ntaskId

deactivate BulkAPI
PublicAPI --> User : taskId + status URL
deactivate PublicAPI

Worker -> SQS : Receive task message
activate Worker

Worker -> Storage : Download uploaded file
Storage --> Worker : input file

Worker -> Worker : Validate and process rows

alt all rows success
  Worker -> Storage : Write success result file
  Worker -> BulkDB : Update status = SUCCESS
else partial failed rows
  Worker -> Storage : Write success result file
  Worker -> Storage : Write failed-results file\nfailed row + reason
  Worker -> BulkDB : Update status = PARTIAL_SUCCESS
else fatal error
  Worker -> Storage : Write failed-results file
  Worker -> BulkDB : Update status = FAILED\nfailure reason
end

deactivate Worker
@enduml

```

## Full Project Class Diagram

```plantuml name=class-diagram
@startuml
title Full Project Class Diagram - Bulk API

' Smetana usually avoids requiring Graphviz/dot for class diagram layout.
' If your local PlantUML ignores this and asks for Graphviz, install Graphviz.
!pragma layout smetana

skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam defaultFontSize 12

package "bulk-api-project" {

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.controller" {
    class BulkTaskController {
      -bulkTaskService: BulkTaskService
      +createTask(request: BulkCreateRequest): BulkCreateResponse
      +getTaskStatus(taskId: String): BulkStatusResponse
      +getTaskResult(taskId: String): BulkResultResponse
      +abortTask(taskId: String): BulkAbortResponse
    }

    class BulkDownloadController {
      -downloadService: BulkDownloadService
      +createDownloadSession(taskId: String): DownloadSessionResponse
      +downloadResult(taskId: String, token: String): Resource
    }
  }

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.service" {
    interface BulkTaskService {
      +createTask(request: BulkCreateRequest): BulkCreateResponse
      +getStatus(taskId: String): BulkStatusResponse
      +getResult(taskId: String): BulkResultResponse
      +abortTask(taskId: String): BulkAbortResponse
    }

    class BulkTaskServiceImpl {
      -taskRepository: BulkTaskRepository
      -sqsPublisher: BulkTaskQueuePublisher
      -storageService: StorageService
      +createTask(request: BulkCreateRequest): BulkCreateResponse
      +getStatus(taskId: String): BulkStatusResponse
      +getResult(taskId: String): BulkResultResponse
      +abortTask(taskId: String): BulkAbortResponse
    }

    interface BulkDownloadService {
      +createDownloadSession(taskId: String): DownloadSessionResponse
      +downloadResult(taskId: String, token: String): Resource
    }

    class BulkDownloadServiceImpl {
      -taskRepository: BulkTaskRepository
      -storageService: StorageService
      -tokenService: DownloadTokenService
      +createDownloadSession(taskId: String): DownloadSessionResponse
      +downloadResult(taskId: String, token: String): Resource
    }

    interface StorageService {
      +upload(key: String, content: byte[]): void
      +download(key: String): byte[]
      +exists(key: String): boolean
      +delete(key: String): void
    }

    class S3StorageService {
      -s3Client: S3Client
      -bucketName: String
    }

    class DownloadTokenService {
      +generateToken(taskId: String): String
      +validateToken(taskId: String, token: String): boolean
      +expireToken(token: String): void
    }
  }

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.queue" {
    interface BulkTaskQueuePublisher {
      +publish(message: BulkTaskMessage): void
    }

    class SqsBulkTaskQueuePublisher {
      -sqsClient: SqsClient
      -queueUrl: String
      +publish(message: BulkTaskMessage): void
    }

    class BulkTaskMessage {
      -taskId: String
      -companyId: String
      -userId: String
      -resourceType: String
      -operationType: String
    }
  }

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.worker" {
    class BulkTaskExecutor {
      -taskRepository: BulkTaskRepository
      -processorFactory: BulkProcessorFactory
      -storageService: StorageService
      +execute(taskId: String): void
    }

    class BulkProcessorFactory {
      -processors: List~BulkProcessor~
      +getProcessor(resourceType: String, operationType: String): BulkProcessor
    }

    interface BulkProcessor {
      +supports(resourceType: String, operationType: String): boolean
      +process(task: BulkTaskEntity): BulkProcessResult
    }

    class BulkImportProcessor {
      +process(task: BulkTaskEntity): BulkProcessResult
    }

    class BulkExportProcessor {
      +process(task: BulkTaskEntity): BulkProcessResult
      -fetchData(task: BulkTaskEntity): List~Object~
    }

    class BulkProcessResult {
      -successCount: int
      -failedCount: int
      -resultFilePath: String
      -failedResultFilePath: String
    }
  }

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.repository" {
    interface BulkTaskRepository {
      +save(entity: BulkTaskEntity): BulkTaskEntity
      +findByTaskId(taskId: String): Optional~BulkTaskEntity~
      +updateStatus(taskId: String, status: BulkTaskStatus): void
      +updateResult(taskId: String, resultPath: String): void
      +updateFailure(taskId: String, reason: String): void
    }
  }

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.entity" {
    class BulkTaskEntity {
      -taskId: String
      -companyId: String
      -userId: String
      -resourceType: String
      -operationType: String
      -status: BulkTaskStatus
      -inputFilePath: String
      -resultFilePath: String
      -failedResultFilePath: String
    }

    enum BulkTaskStatus {
      CREATED
      QUEUED
      RUNNING
      SUCCESS
      PARTIAL_SUCCESS
      FAILED
      ABORTED
    }
  }

  package "porters.hr.api.bulk.dto" {
    class BulkCreateRequest
    class BulkCreateResponse
    class BulkStatusResponse
    class BulkResultResponse
    class BulkAbortResponse
    class DownloadSessionResponse
  }
}

BulkTaskController --> BulkTaskService
BulkDownloadController --> BulkDownloadService

BulkTaskService <|.. BulkTaskServiceImpl
BulkDownloadService <|.. BulkDownloadServiceImpl
StorageService <|.. S3StorageService
BulkTaskQueuePublisher <|.. SqsBulkTaskQueuePublisher

BulkTaskServiceImpl --> BulkTaskRepository
BulkTaskServiceImpl --> BulkTaskQueuePublisher
BulkTaskServiceImpl --> StorageService

BulkDownloadServiceImpl --> BulkTaskRepository
BulkDownloadServiceImpl --> StorageService
BulkDownloadServiceImpl --> DownloadTokenService

SqsBulkTaskQueuePublisher --> BulkTaskMessage

BulkTaskExecutor --> BulkTaskRepository
BulkTaskExecutor --> BulkProcessorFactory
BulkTaskExecutor --> StorageService

BulkProcessorFactory --> BulkProcessor
BulkProcessor <|.. BulkImportProcessor
BulkProcessor <|.. BulkExportProcessor

BulkImportProcessor --> BulkProcessResult
BulkExportProcessor --> BulkProcessResult

BulkTaskRepository --> BulkTaskEntity
BulkTaskEntity --> BulkTaskStatus

BulkCreateResponse ..> BulkTaskEntity
BulkStatusResponse ..> BulkTaskEntity
BulkResultResponse ..> BulkTaskEntity

@enduml
```

### Inline KaTeX Math
Einstein's formula is $E = mc^2$.

The quadratic formula is $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.

The cost is $100, so this dollar sign should not become math.

---
### Block KaTeX Math

$$
\int_0^1 x^2 , dx = \frac{1}{3}
$$

$$
\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x} = 1
$$

---
### Matrix Test

$$
A =
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 2 \
3 & 4
\end{bmatrix}
$$

$$
A^{-1}
=

\frac{1}{ad - bc}
\begin{bmatrix}
d & -b \
-c & a
\end{bmatrix}
$$

---
## Aligned Equation Test

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x) &= x^2 + 2x + 1 \
&= (x + 1)^2
\end{aligned}
$$
